name: DatabaseSandbox
summary: Gives each developer and each run a database of its own, so that tests touching a database do not touch each other's.

roles.name: DatabaseSandbox
roles.summary: The participant that hands a test its own schema, its own instance, or its own slice of one. It is what makes database tests runnable in parallel and on a laptop at the same time as on the build — and its absence is not a defect anybody sees until two runs collide, which is why saying it is present is worth a line.
